title: Mark UI
tagline: The Mark dapp hackathon project provides a UI to connect creators with licensing.
description:
The Mark Token UI is an implementation of an interface for Spectacle Inc.'s Mark Token platform. Mark is a licensing platform that connects NFT creators with the holders of the rights to their content. For more information visit the project website at 

https://spctcl.github.io/mark_hackathon_dapp_website/
how_its_made:
This hackathon portion of this project was built from scratch and the project uses the Rayonism merge testnet, and the scaffold.eth framwork.



https://github.com/protolambda/mergenet-tutorial

https://github.com/austintgriffith/scaffold-eth



Information on how to use these libraries is available on their respective Github pages.
